thread:
Aisha: Quick sync  proposing a lightweight 6-week "SI Marketplace Accelerator" to speed SI onboarding across cloud marketplaces + hardware partners. Goals: training + playbook + graded lab + listing checklist. Pilot cohort = 6. Thoughts? :rocket:

Marco: Good idea. We need a concrete listing readiness checklist (manifest, support SLA, security attestation) and to map those items to certification gates. Also add expected review lead times per cloud.

Lena: Curriculum owner here. Recommend tiered certs: Associate (listing basics), Integrator (deploy + perf validation), Premier (refs + co-sell). I'll sketch a 6-week syllabus and lab exercises.

Diego: From hardware ops: I'll provide a reference stack (e.g., A100 8x50Gb), driver/firmware checklist, and a small perf harness. Include thermal and driver checks in the runbook.

Ben: Exam idea: practical deploy to ephemeral sandbox + short MC quiz. Weighting: 80% practical, 20% MC. Passing: practical >=80% and overall >=75%. Practical must produce logs + perf.json.

Raj: Marketing wants Premier to require a joint case study (or customer reference) within 6 months and requests a modular co-sell deck + 1-pager template. Legal: we need an MOU for co-marketing.

Legal: We have a template we can adapt. I'll post the link and required clauses (data sharing, logos, mutual PR approvals). Loop us early.

Lena: Labs infra plan: GH Actions to spin ephemeral sandboxes, a scoring webhook that grades artifacts (logs, perf.json, manifest), and a simple rubric for graders. Need infra owners for quotas.

Marco: I'll share sample manifests for AWS/Azure/GCP and propose a mapping doc that ties each marketplace gate to a cert deliverable. Also will coordinate with PMs for listing windows aligned to demo day.

Aisha: Action items & owners: Aisha 00: draft certification matrix + intake form (Tue 9am); Lena: module outlines + labs scaffold (Wed); Marco: marketplace manifests + checklist (Tue); Diego: reference stack + perf thresholds (Thu); Raj: marketing templates (Fri).

Integrations-Bot: New doc created: https://redwood.docs/si-marketplace-accelerator/overview (draft). Tag: partnerships/si-accelerator.

Aisha: I'll create a pilot Slack channel (#si-marketplace-accelerator-pilot) and an intake form. Pilot kickoff target: 3 weeks out; demo day end of week 9. We'll run a retro and publish an improvement backlog. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
